rows: `backend/service-kit` (PR #332, report `docs/audits/reports/backend-service-kit.md`): one crate replaces the telemetry, log, limiter and heartbeat code both backends carried by hand (490 lines in each service) with 579 shared lines (tracing + OTLP, the redaction layer, the request trace layer, the tower_governor rate limit, heartbeat, shutdown; since then also the secret loader and a JSON refusal helper). Cost per service: about 3.5 MB of binary and 4 MB of resident memory. Verified through its users: leetcode-backend black box 79 of 79, remote-chat-agent 314 of 314, capture 20 of 20 and reporting-service 39 of 39 on deploy-profile binaries. The one documented exception to "no hand-rolled code" is its redaction layer.
